title: Gatekeeper probe: a hand-made zip opens on macOS 26 with Open Anyway

history.what: Probe ready (not the real Tether, so it can't clash with the running one): TetherGatekeeperProbe.app, bundle id com.tether.gatekeeper-probe, universal, Sparkle.framework embedded and signed inside out with a self-signed 'Tether Release'-style identity, the same codesign flags as build-app.sh --release (no hardened runtime, --timestamp=none), zipped with ditto; spctl rejects it as expected. On draft release https://github.com/jordanromines-jpg/tether/releases/tag/untagged-91ce7af59446643f91a6 (asset TetherGatekeeperProbe.zip, only visible signed in to GitHub). Pass = the window 'Gatekeeper probe OK' opens after Open Anyway.

body: Early check for R-2, before PR-2's 7.5 h: zip the --release build from S-3, send it to a Mac on macOS 26 through a browser download (so it is quarantined), and open it. If there is no Open Anyway, the plan stops for Jordan.
done_when: the downloaded zip's app opens after System Settings → Privacy and Security → Open Anyway
